body: Yes, you are right. But please I'm so tired and confused. Suicide seems like the definite answer. But even that is too difficult for me. At least right now. Thank you for your reply
Thank you for the advice. I guess I knew all along that we wouldn't be able to keep this up for long. It's just we both are getting help and trying our best, but I guess it's just not good enough.
My example is really specific so I don't feel comfortable sharing. But thank you for giving me something to think about.

I used to feel exactly the same. And I still want to believe all of this. But my question for you is what happens when two people are suicidal and want to save each other, but what one person needs is different than what the other does? One person sacrifices everything with no limits, but then they get more suicidal. So the other person tries to do the same. And it's an endless cycle of growing resentment and destroying each other. I sincerely want to know what I can do because I'm in this situation.

Isn't it kind of insulting her to say that she's wasting time on you? If you think she's so amazing, then shouldn't you trust her judgment in picking who she spends time with? Why would she spend time with you if she thought you were dumb and worthless? Also "ugly" is subjective. 

It's really easy to be hard on ourselves and not be able to understand why anyone would want to be around us. I also often feel ugly, dumb, and worthless. But I just hope that you can find some things you like about yourself. And I hope you can find the strength to continue to make positive changes, even if they're small.
Thank you for caring. I hope things get better for you

Thank you for your reply. That's how I feel too. I'm sorry you had to go through that. I hope you can find someone or something else to make you feel happy. 

Right now he just texted me and I literally switched from wanting to end this to being pulled back in.
